item.title: ISLAND HISTORY: Kauai sugar pioneer George Norton Wilcox never married
item.description: George Norton Wilcox (1839-1933) was born in Hilo of missionary parents, was raised at Waioli, Kauai, and became the owner of Kauai’s Grove Farm Plantation.

item.title: TAX MAN: Income tax cut: Pause versus stop
item.description: In 2024, we in Hawaii became the beneficiaries of Act 46 (House Bill 2404) which the Governor’s Office called the “largest income tax cut for working families in the state’s history.”

item.title: Trump allies wipe out U.S. climate regulation
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — In the summer of 2022, Democrats in Congress were racing to pass the biggest climate law in the country’s history and President Joe Biden was declaring that global warming posed a “clear and present danger” to the United States.

item.title: Public urged to practice fireworks safety on Lunar New Year
item.description: LIHUE — The Kauai Fire Department strongly urges residents to prioritize fireworks safety on Feb. 17, the Lunar New Year.

item.title: Uproar over Sylvia Luke forces Green to cancel out-of-state trip
item.description: Lt. Gov. Sylvia Luke will not serve as acting governor this month after Gov. Josh Green announced Thursday that he has canceled his scheduled trip to Washington, D.C., to attend the National Governors Association meeting, as questions swirl over whether Luke is the focus of a state investigation.

item.title: Native Hawaiian help available on Monday
item.description: LIHUE — The Hawaiian Council will be on Kauai Monday to continue its statewide effort to help Native Hawaiian beneficiaries applying for the Office of Hawaiian Affairs (OHA) Emergency Relief Fund.

item.title: Kupuna enjoy Valentine’s Dance
item.description: Melanie Okamoto of the county’s Department of Parks and Recreation said Friday was the first time Na Kupuna Council used the Koloa Landing Resort as the site for the annual Senior Valentine’s Dance.

item.title: Puhi boy Jerik Centeno releases album
item.description: Jerik Centeno, a 2013 alumnus of Kauai High School and currently a Los Angeles-based film composer, producer and mix engineer, released his musical score for the film “Riley” on Friday.
